title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once upon a time, there was a fox. The fox lived in a small forest near a river. He was very hungry every day. One morning, he saw a crow in a tree. The crow had a piece of cheese.

The fox wanted the cheese. He said, "You are so beautiful! Please sing for me." The crow was happy and opened its beak to sing. The cheese fell to the ground. The fox ate it and ran away.

options: In a small forest near a river
In a house by the sea

questions.text: What did the fox ask the crow to do?
Why did the fox say the crow was beautiful?
options: He wanted to make a new friend
He wanted to learn to sing

questions.text: How did the fox feel at the end of the story?

paragraph_translations: Dawno, dawno temu żył sobie lis. Lis mieszkał w małym lesie obok rzeki. Każdego dnia był bardzo głodny. Pewnego ranka zobaczył kruka na drzewie. Kruk miał kawałek sera.
Lis chciał ten ser. Powiedział: „Jesteś piękny! Proszę, zaśpiewaj dla mnie.” Kruk się ucieszył i otworzył dziób, żeby zaśpiewać. Ser spadł na ziemię. Lis zjadł go i uciekł.
